module_name: Keyboard walk over the panels of a form
input: The panels of the form in the order of its layout contract (tab_order), the action ids of its pool tabs and of its source dock buttons, and every catalog action from a key or a click.
output: Per action: left to the caller, taken here (panel changed, dock button chosen, card grid step), or another catalog action it stands for (a pool tab, a dock button); the view of the focus for drawing.
specification: User rules 2026-10-13: Tab walks the panels of a form in the order its layout contract gives; Enter confirms in a panel and with nothing to confirm goes on to the next one; the keys act on the panel in focus; the dock buttons are part of the source timeline panel.
